summary: Controlled re-entry: 4 sessions of pure Z1-Z2 work, knee-safe strength only, habit-building over intensity — recover from bilateral anterior knee pain and sleep deficit

sessions.name: Aerobic Base Ride
sessions.focus: Aerobic base development — sustained Z2 power to build mitochondrial density and fat oxidation capacity

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, 80–85 rpm, let legs wake up — keep power relaxed below 90W
Z2 steady aerobic — 106–130W, cadence 85–90 rpm, HR 146–158 bpm, conversational effort throughout
Z1 easy spin-down, reduce cadence gradually to 70 rpm, breathe and relax

sessions.name: Posterior Chain & Anti-Rotation Core
sessions.focus: Build glute and hamstring strength to offload anterior knee stress, plus anti-rotation core stability — zero spinal flexion under load, zero patellar-loading movements
sessions.notes: 3 rounds of: Romanian Deadlift 2x11kg x10 reps (hip hinge, soft knee only); TRX Glute Bridge x15 reps (bodyweight, shoulders on floor); Single-Leg Hip Hinge 1x6kg x8/side; Pallof Press light band x10/side (hold 2s at extension); Dead Bug bodyweight x8/side (slow, back flat); Farmer Carry 2x11kg x20m. 60s rest between rounds. RIR 2-3 throughout. Shoulder: no overhead or pressing movements.

steps.description: Hip circles x10 each direction, bodyweight glute bridge x15 slow, band clamshells x15/side, shallow bodyweight squat sit x10 — heels elevated if knees uncomfortable
Romanian Deadlift — 2x11 kg, 10 reps. Push hips back, soft knee, hinge not squat. Z2 effort.
Transition — set down weights, move to floor
TRX Glute Bridge — bodyweight, 15 reps. Shoulders on floor, drive hips to full extension and squeeze.
Transition — stand up, pick up 6 kg
Single-Leg Hip Hinge — 1x6 kg, 8 reps/side. Balance and control over load. Touch wall if unstable.
Transition — anchor band at door handle height
Pallof Press — light band, 10 reps/side. Press out, hold 2s at full extension. No rotation.
Transition — move to floor mat
Dead Bug — bodyweight, 8 reps/side. Lower back flat on floor throughout. Slow and controlled.
Transition — pick up 2x11 kg
Farmer Carry — 2x11 kg, walk 20m. Core braced, shoulders down and back, tall posture.
Rest between rounds — walk slowly, shake out hands and legs
Kneeling hip flexor stretch 30s/side, lying figure-four glute stretch 30s/side, supine hamstring stretch 30s/side, seated thoracic rotation 10 reps/side

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Run
sessions.focus: Maintain neuromuscular running patterns and aerobic stimulus at Z1–Z2 — zero knee aggravation priority, flat terrain only

steps.description: 3 min walk then 2 min very easy jog >7:00/km — Z1, HR under 145 bpm. Dynamic drills: leg swings, ankle circles. Keep it gentle — no bounding.
Z1–Z2 easy continuous run — 6:15–7:00/km, HR 145–162 bpm. Flat terrain only. Conversational pace. Walk immediately if any knee pain.
Easy walk cool-down >8:00/km — let HR drop below 130 bpm before stopping

sessions.name: Aerobic Long Ride
sessions.focus: Extended aerobic volume — primary weekly calorie-expenditure session and mitochondrial adaptation at low-moderate intensity, progressive within Z2

steps.description: Z1 spin-up — 7 min easy, 80–85 rpm, HR below 145 bpm. Increase cadence to 88 rpm in final 2 min.
Low Z1–Z2 — 95–115W, cadence 85–88 rpm, HR 145–154 bpm. Let HR stabilise before progressing.
Mid Z2 — 110–130W, cadence 85–90 rpm, HR 152–160 bpm. Steady aerobic — still conversational.
Hold steady Z2 — 106–122W, back off if HR climbs above 162 bpm. Finish strong but controlled.
Z1 easy spin-down — reduce wattage and cadence gradually over 8 min. HR below 130 bpm before stopping.

summary: Base consolidation: extend ride duration modestly, introduce steady-state aerobic run slightly longer, add one low-load unilateral leg exercise in strength if knees allow — TSS rises ~18%

sessions.name: Aerobic Base Ride Extended
sessions.focus: Extend Z2 duration to 25 min continuous — aerobic volume accumulation

sessions.name: Posterior Chain & Core — Load Progression
sessions.focus: Add step-up from 11 kg to 16 kg RDL if pain-free; introduce TRX single-leg balance for hip stability

sessions.name: Easy Run — Duration Extension
sessions.focus: Extend easy Z2 run to 25 min — aerobic base with neuromuscular continuity

sessions.name: Long Aerobic Ride
sessions.focus: 60-min Z1-Z2 ride — largest aerobic stimulus of the week, fat oxidation priority

summary: Build phase entry: introduce 1 quality cycling session (sweet-spot Z3 blocks), extend long ride, maintain easy run — TSS rises ~24% with hard day isolated and followed by rest

sessions.name: Sweet-Spot Intervals — 3x8min
sessions.focus: First quality cycling session — 3x8 min at Z3 (142-165W) to begin raising FTP and lactate threshold

sessions.name: Posterior Chain — Strength Emphasis
sessions.focus: Progress RDL load, add TRX single-leg RDL, maintain anti-rotation core — knee reassessment checkpoint

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Run
sessions.focus: Z1-Z2 easy run 30 min — maintain running economy, recover from quality ride two days prior

sessions.name: Long Aerobic Ride
sessions.focus: 65-min Z2 long ride — aerobic volume base, fat metabolism, weekly calorie expenditure peak

summary: Recovery week: drop TSS ~57% from peak, easy sessions only, no quality work — allow supercompensation from 3-week base-build arc, reassess knees and sleep before next block

sessions.name: Easy Recovery Spin
sessions.focus: Z1 active recovery — flush legs, maintain habit, no aerobic stress

sessions.name: Light Mobility & Core
sessions.focus: Reduced volume strength — core anti-rotation only, mobility priority, consolidate tissue adaptations

sessions.name: Easy Long Ride — Recovery Pace
sessions.focus: 45-min Z1-low Z2 ride — aerobic maintenance without accumulating fatigue, mental refresh
